description: This Java source file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView component for Android that displays log data received via the LogNode interface. It formats log messages with priority, tag, message, and exception details, and supports chaining with other LogNodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting and displaying log messages in the UI.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log data and outputs it to the LogView, handling priority, tag, message, and exceptions, and ensures thread-safe UI updates.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Appends a string to the StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Outputs the string as a new line in the LogView.
